title: Godot 2D
intro: One preset for design, development, running and verification in an explicitly bound Godot project.
enabledHint: After a valid save, an eligible session in the current definition can connect. Disabling revokes new dispatches and waits for cleanup; in-flight writes may have applied.
projectRootHint: Absolute path containing project.godot. The editor, session workspace and bound project must agree.
godotExecutableHint: An existing absolute executable path. Acceptance target: Godot 4.7.2; no automatic installation or upgrade.
http: Existing loopback HTTP service · candidate, unavailable in v0.1
httpUnavailable: HTTP is a candidate and cannot be enabled in this release. The native client cannot guarantee that every redirected request remains on loopback. Saved references are shown read-only; select the installed local stdio bridge to continue.
bridgeExecutableHint: Use the isolated environment's absolute bin/python invocation path; keep its symlink path. The Host checks Python and the pinned imports, then launches the project guard with -I -B. Do not select a console entrypoint or script.
bridgeUrlHint: A dedicated loopback ws:// address with an explicit port. Configure the Godot addon to match; never take over an occupied port.
bridgeSecretRefHint: Environment variable name only, for example DSH_GODOT_BRIDGE_TOKEN. Never paste the token value here.
bridgeEndpointHint: An existing http:// loopback endpoint. This mode leaves the externally owned service and its editor bridge settings under your control.
httpSecretRefHint: Environment variable name only. Credentials are resolved by the Host and are not put into the prompt or plugin export.
optionalHint: Only READY tools that you allow enter this preset's usage guidance. No tool is installed by selecting it. These switches are usage conventions, not a sandbox for arbitrary shell commands.
gdtoolkitPurpose: GDScript linting and formatting; inspect a formatting diff before accepting it.
imagemagickPurpose: 2D image conversion, dimensions and alpha inspection.
ffmpegPurpose: Audio/video metadata and conversion using the installed build.
optionalPathHint: Absolute path; leave blank to report it as unconfigured. Detection does not download anything.
candidates: Pixelorama, Gua, DCC and other catalog entries remain candidates unless separately implemented and verified. Project addons and new test frameworks need separate permission to install.
testsHint: Use the project's existing tests and CI. This setting does not install or remove GUT, gdUnit4, .NET or C++ test dependencies.
healthUnavailable: No Host diagnostic has been received. A saved configuration alone does not prove an editor connection or successful verification.
restart: After changing a project, program or endpoint, open a new Godot 2D session. Retired plugin-definition sessions also require a new session. Re-enabling the same target can reconnect its eligible session after cleanup without restarting the Profile.
boundary: One explicitly bound project and one editor write channel. The plugin preserves DSH approvals; tool discovery is not authorization. Local processes, editor scripts and the running game are not a universal file sandbox. Cancelled writes are observed before retrying.
saved: Configuration saved. Review the owner and saved/applied generations below. A changed target requires a new session.
revoked: Bridge disabled. New dispatches are revoked; observe any in-flight operation before retrying.
disableFailed: The Host did not accept bridge disablement. Its last accepted preference remains active; retry before relying on revocation.
saveFailed: The Host refused this save or its revision changed. Your draft is retained. Review the latest configuration and merge it before retrying.
changed: The saved configuration changed while you were editing. Your draft is retained.
readOnly: This Host exposes settings as read-only.
unavailable: The Host is not serving GameDev settings.
invalidSummary: Correct the fields below. Nothing was saved.
absolutePath: Enter an absolute path, or leave this optional field blank.
loopbackWs: Use ws://localhost, ws://127.0.0.1 or ws://[::1] with an explicit dedicated port and no credentials, query or fragment.
loopbackHttp: Use an http:// loopback endpoint with no embedded credentials, query or fragment.
envRef: Enter an environment variable name such as DSH_GODOT_BRIDGE_TOKEN, or leave blank. Do not enter a secret value.
